name: Confirm
summary: Asks the user to confirm a consequential or destructive action, showing what will happen.

title.description: Question naming the action ('Send £250 to Alex?')

consequence.description: What happens and whether it can be undone

summary.description: Optional DetailList summarising what is being confirmed

typeToConfirm.description: Text the user must type before confirming (for irreversible, high-impact actions)

whenToUse: Moving money, deleting data, sending on someone's behalf, anything irreversible

requirements: Focus starts on the least destructive option
Confirm label repeats the action verb

agent: Reads title and consequence; confirm and cancel are named buttons.
rendering: Capabilities with high risk level must use Confirm (enforced by the verifier)
